text:
noah.g: heads up — customs in NL flagged a partial H100 pallet for "re-marked serials". They want OEM CO + refurb trace before release. Holding 8 units under AWB NL-775331. This will pinch eu-prod tomorrow if not resolved.

tara.s: ETA on OEM CO? can vendor do provisional release? we also have 4 loaners in rotterdam.

vendor-nordic: OEM CO may take 4872h. We can request provisional release via bonded broker — estimated fee 3k and 68h release window. Alternatively we can ship loaners separately if Redwood signs return PO.

logi-lee: broker quote 3.2k for provisional release door-to-door 68h. SkyLane loaner courier quote 4.8k door-to-door 14h. Warehouse can prep 4 loaners immediate dispatch if vendor issues loaner AWB.

warehouse-rotterdam: confirm we have 4 hot-rack H100s ready. Need RMA CSV: SERIAL, MODEL, LOAN_AWB, RETURN_AWB, CONDITION. Also note one unit shows higher fan cycles in last 7d — ops wants quick 15m burn.

noah.g: ops, confirm impact if we short these 8 units? we need to know finance leeway.

ops (via message): predicted shortfall ~6 H100-equivalents for peak window in 36h. Canary latency +8% p99 on real-time features. Recommend loaner injection or cross-region routing.

finance-rene: vendor offered 1k credit toward customs fees. Procurement limit for immediate spend > 3k needs two approvals. I can approve up to 3.5k emergency for logistics if ops marks critical.

tara.s: ops marked critical. I'll sign return PO and SLA for loaners. vendor, can you issue loan AWB within 3h?

vendor-nordic: can do LOAN-NORD-220 AWB in ~4h once we receive signed return PO. We'll mark CI as "Temporary loan  return required" and include refurb trace PDF.

logi-lee: prepping SkyLane standby; if vendor can't ship in 4h we'll trigger SkyLane (4.8k). warehouse to run 15m burn then pack.

warehouse-rotterdam: will run burn and prep RMA CSV. Template ready, attaching in internal tracker.

noah.g: recap: (1) tara to sign return PO + SLA; (2) vendor to issue LOAN-NORD-220 with "temporary loan" CI; (3) warehouse run QA and prep labels; (4) finance to issue emergency release up to 3.5k or trigger SkyLane if vendor misses window. I'll follow up in 3h.

vendor-nordic: acknowledged. Starting paperwork now.

finance-rene: noted vendor credit and temp approval. Please tag me when AWB issued so I can finalize PO.
